title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Guintoloan, Municipality of Naga, Province of Zamboanga Sibugay to Be Known as Guintoloan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Guintoloan, Municipality of Naga, Province of Zamboanga Sibugay to Be Known as Guintoloan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Guintoloan, Thị trấn Naga, Tỉnh Zamboanga Sibugay được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Guintoloan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Guintoloan, เทศบาล Naga, จังหวัด Zamboanga Sibugay ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Guintoloan
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Guintoloan, Kotamadya Naga, Provinsi Zamboanga Sibugay dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Guintoloan
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Guintoloan, Perbandaran Naga, Wilayah Zamboanga Sibugay dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Guintoloan

text.en: Establishment of a National High School. - There shall be established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay Guintoloan, Municipality of Naga, Province of Zamboanga Sibugay to be known as Guintoloan National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Guintoloan National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
